question: If someone gives you a large cash gift, do you as the recipient generally owe federal tax on it?
true_option: No — the recipient generally owes no federal gift or income tax; the giver generally handles required gift-tax filing
false_option: Yes — the recipient must report the gift as taxable income
true_claim_text: gift recipients generally owe no federal tax; the giver generally handles required gift-tax filing
false_claim_text: gift recipients must report gifts as taxable income
source: IRS, Frequently Asked Questions on Gift Taxes: the donor is generally responsible for paying the gift tax and filing Form 709; gifts are not treated as income to the recipient under IRC § 102.
